Chan Hao-ching ( Chinese : 詹皓晴 ; pinyin : Zhān Hàoqíng ; Taiwanese Mandarin: [tsán.xâu.tɕʰǐŋ] ; born September 19, 1993), also known as Angel Chan , is a Taiwanese professional tennis player. She is primarily a doubles specialist, having won twenty-one WTA Tour, two WTA Challenger and six ITF titles in that discipline.
